proof_summary: Using \(4\cos^2\theta-2=2\cos(2\theta)\) and \(C_{13}(2\cos\theta)=2\cos(13\theta)\), the proof makes the six cosine values roots of a monic degree-six polynomial via the explicit identities \(C_{13}(x)-2=(x-2)Q(x)^2\) and \(P(t)=Q(t-2)\). Cosine’s injectivity on \([0,\pi]\) makes these roots distinct, so they exhaust the roots of \(P\); reversing coefficients then gives the desired denominator factorization.
